description: This file contains utility functions for performance microbenchmark testing in PyTorch, including configuration generation, random sampling, and string manipulation.

classes.name: RandomSample
classes.description: A class for generating random samples based on configured probabilities, supporting cumulative distribution calculation and sampling.

methods.name: shape_to_string
methods.description: Converts a shape tuple/list into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: str2bool
methods.description: Converts a string to a boolean value, raising an error if the string is not a recognized boolean.

methods.name: numpy_random
methods.description: Returns a numpy tensor of specified dtype and shape with random values.

methods.name: cross_product
methods.description: Returns the Cartesian product of input iterables.

methods.name: get_n_rand_nums
methods.description: Generates a list of n unique random numbers within a specified range.

methods.name: generate_configs
methods.description: Generates configuration combinations based on user inputs and a sampling function.

methods.name: cross_product_configs
methods.description: Generates all combinations of configuration options for cross product.

methods.name: config_list
methods.description: Creates a list of configuration dictionaries based on input shapes and cross configurations.

methods.name: attr_probs
methods.description: Returns input probabilities as a dictionary.

methods.name: RandomSample._distribution_func
methods.description: Calculates and caches the cumulative distribution function for sampling.

methods.name: RandomSample._random_sample
methods.description: Samples a value based on weights using the cached distribution.

methods.name: RandomSample.get_one_set_of_inputs
methods.description: Generates a single set of input configurations based on probabilities.

methods.name: random_sample_configs
methods.description: Samples multiple configuration sets based on weights and total sample count.

methods.name: op_list
methods.description: Generates a list of operator configurations with names and functions.

methods.name: get_operator_range
methods.description: Generates a set of operator starting characters based on a range string.

methods.name: process_arg_list
methods.description: Processes a comma-separated argument list into a list of strings.
